Redundancy: the unknown-priority/corrupt-log traceback conflict is restated in 4 places (tickets.md TKT-014 TODO, priorities.md PRI-003 TODO, event-log.md LOG-005 TODO, architecture.md CLI section). The 'due time not shown' gap is stated in priorities.md intro and architecture.md.
